message.content: 神舟八号（Shenzhou 8）是中国空间站计划中的一次无人试验飞行，主要用于验证对接技术。它于2008年9月25日发射，成功与天宫一号对接，但没有搭载任何宇航员。
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew members of Shenzhou 8. We need to answer. According to known facts: Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight in 2008, part of the Shenzhou program. It was an unmanned test flight? Wait, Shenzhou 8 was the first test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft with a docking test with Tiangong-1. Actually Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight? Let's recall: Shenzhou 7 was the first manned flight (with Yang Liwei). Shenzhou 8 was the second test flight, but it was unmanned? Actually Shenzhou 8 was the first test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft's docking system, but it was unmanned. It launched on 25 September 2008. It docked with Tiangong-1. So there were no astronauts aboard Shenzhou 8. So answer: No astronauts; it was unmanned. But maybe the question expects "Shenzhou 8 had no crew; it was an unmanned test flight." Provide that. Also mention the mission details. So answer in Chinese: "Shenzhou 8 是一次无人试验飞行，没有宇航员。"

Thus respond accordingly.
